notes: 'together' at t013 is kept inside כְּנוֹס's unit as a phrasal particle of 'gather together', discontinuous around the object under rule 25; the competing reading marks it added, but dropping it diminishes the verb's rendering rather than removing a predication the Hebrew never wrote.
s015-s017: 'refrain' renders רָחַק, the written מִן takes 'from', and the Piel infinitive takes 'embracing'; each morpheme holds a word of its own, so rule 30 does not fuse them.
